tasks.old_behavior: WPS Key credential accepted only as 8..63 byte UTF-8 passphrase; 64-byte hex PSK was rejected with 'WPS: ignore invalid PSK' log message.
tasks.new_behavior: WPS Key credential accepted as 8..63 byte UTF-8 passphrase OR 64-byte hex PSK via nm_wifi_utils_wps_key_to_psk(). 64 hex-char valid WPA-PSKs are now successfully processed.
tasks.compatibility_reason: The callback relaxes the WPS Key input contract to accept 64 hex-character PSKs in addition to 8..63 character passphrases. This is an additive/relaxed change: previously-rejected valid WPA-PSKs are now accepted. Existing 8..63 byte passphrases continue to work identically. The change only affects the WPS credential provisioning path triggered by compatible access points.
tasks.test_recommendation: Run the existing test-devices-wifi test binary which includes the dedicated test_wps_key_to_psk() test cases covering passphrases (8-63), 64 hex-char PSKs (valid/invalid hex characters), empty keys, overlong keys (65+), and embedded NUL. Also verify actual WPS credential processing through the callback.
